description: This file defines interfaces and structures for a compositor client, including display, surface, keyboard, pointer, wheel, and touch panel abstractions, with licensing and environment-based configuration methods.

classes.name: IDisplay
classes.description: Interface for display management in the compositor, including methods for creating surfaces, processing data, and retrieving display info.

classes.name: IDisplay::ISurface
classes.description: Interface representing a drawable surface with methods for rendering, resizing, and retrieving native window info.

classes.name: IDisplay::ISurface::ICallback
classes.description: Callback interface for surface rendering and publication events.

classes.name: IDisplay::ITouchPanel
classes.description: Interface for touch panel input handling.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of the display interface for a given name.

methods.name: SuggestedName
methods.description: Retrieves a suggested display name based on environment variable 'CLIENT_IDENTIFIER'.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves additional configuration info from 'CLIENT_IDENTIFIER' environment variable.
